composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# An 'Idempotency-Key' header makes the create idempotent: a repeat with an already-seen key
# replays the originally created owner (200) via the 'existing' branch instead of running the
# create pipeline (which would otherwise 409 as a duplicate). An unseen key (or no header)
# takes the 'create' branch — the normal validate-and-create chain below.
route:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RouteIdempotentCreate
  outputs:
    create: validate
    existing: respondExisting

respondExisting:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithExistingOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireOwnerFields
  next: postcode

# Validate the optional postcode WHEN PRESENT (4 digits, and within the city region's range for a
# known region). Absent postcode is accepted, keeping the request contract backward-compatible.
postcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequirePostcode
  next: uniqueIdentity

# Single consolidated duplicate check: reject 409 only when the new owner's WHOLE identityKey
# (SHA-256 hex of normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)) equals an
# existing owner's. Replaces the former separate telephone, email and household checks.
uniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: cityCapacity
cityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: futureDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date (400). Runs on the raw
# request value, before DetermineRegistrationDate defaults/adjusts it.
futureDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireNotFutureRegistrationDate
  next: determineDate

determineDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DetermineRegistrationDate
  next: dailyLimit

dailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesake

assignNamesake:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkWarning

assignBulkWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Flag a city approaching its capacity limit: capacityWarning is true when the city already holds
# 40-49 owners (the hard rejection at 50 is enforced earlier by RequireCityCapacity). Runs before
# save so the owner being created is not counted against itself.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Flag a soft duplicate: an existing owner with a different identityKey that shares this owner's
# soundex(lastName) and postcode. Runs before save so the owner is not matched against itself.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembership

# Cap the new owner's membershipLevel at one above the current maximum among their household
# members. Runs before save so the owner is not counted against itself; no existing member = no cap.
capMembership:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: record

# Remember this owner against the request's Idempotency-Key (when present) so a repeat replays it.
# Runs after save so the owner has its persisted id; no-op when no key was supplied.
record:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

2	  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"
3	
4	# An 'Idempotency-Key' header makes the create idempotent: a repeat with an already-seen key
5	# replays the originally created owner (200) via the 'existing' branch instead of running the
6	# create pipeline (which would otherwise 409 as a duplicate). An unseen key (or no header)
7	# takes the 'create' branch — the normal validate-and-create chain below.
8	route:
9	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RouteIdempotentCreate
10	  outputs:
11	    create: validate
12	    existing: respondExisting
13	
14	respondExisting:
15	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithExistingOwner
16	  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
17	
18	validate:
19	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireOwnerFields
20	  next: postcode
21	
22	# Validate the optional postcode WHEN PRESENT (4 digits, and within the city region's range for a
23	# known region). Absent postcode is accepted, keeping the request contract backward-compatible.
24	postcode:
25	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequirePostcode
26	  next: uniqueIdentity
27	
28	# Single consolidated duplicate check: reject 409 only when the new owner's WHOLE identityKey
29	# (SHA-256 hex of normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)) equals an
30	# existing owner's. Replaces the former separate telephone, email and household checks.
31	uniqueIdentity:
32	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireUniqueIdentity
33	  govern: [ transaction ]
34	  next: cityCapacity
35	cityCapacity:
36	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireCityCapacity
37	  govern: [ transaction ]
38	  next: futureDate
39	
40	# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date (400). Runs on the raw
41	# request value, before DetermineRegistrationDate defaults/adjusts it.
42	futureDate:
43	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireNotFutureRegistrationDate
44	  next: determineDate
45	
46	determineDate:
47	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DetermineRegistrationDate
48	  next: dailyLimit
49	
50	dailyLimit:
51	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireDailyOwnerLimit
52	  govern: [ transaction ]
53	  next: build
54	
55	build:
56	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
57	  govern: [ transaction ]
58	  next: assignHousehold
59	
60	assignHousehold:
61	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
62	  govern: [ transaction ]
63	  next: assignCode
64	
65	assignCode:
66	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
67	  govern: [ transaction ]
68	  next: assignNamesake
69	
70	assignNamesake:
71	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
72	  govern: [ transaction ]
73	  next: assignHouseholdSize
74	
75	assignHouseholdSize:
76	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
77	  govern: [ transaction ]
78	  next: assignBulkWarning
79	
80	assignBulkWarning:
81	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
82	  govern: [ transaction ]
83	  next: assignCapacityWarning
84	
85	# Flag a city approaching its capacity limit: capacityWarning is true when the city already holds
86	# 40-49 owners (the hard rejection at 50 is enforced earlier by RequireCityCapacity). Runs before
87	# save so the owner being created is not counted against itself.
88	assignCapacityWarning:
89	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
90	  govern: [ transaction ]
91	  next: assignPossibleDuplicate
92	
93	# Flag a soft duplicate: an existing owner with a different identityKey that shares this owner's
94	# soundex(lastName) and postcode. Runs before save so the owner is not matched against itself.
95	assignPossibleDuplicate:
96	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
97	  govern: [ transaction ]
98	  next: capMembership
99	
100	# Cap the new owner's membershipLevel at one above the current maximum among their household
101	# members. Runs before save so the owner is not counted against itself; no existing member = no cap.
102	capMembership:
103	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
104	  govern: [ transaction ]
105	  next: save
106	
107	save:
108	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
109	  govern: [ transaction ]
110	  next: record
111	
112	# Remember this owner against the request's Idempotency-Key (when present) so a repeat replays it.
113	# Runs after save so the owner has its persisted id; no-op when no key was supplied.
114	record:
115	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
116	  govern: [ transaction ]
117	  next: audit
118	
119	audit:
120	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
121	  govern: [ transaction ]
122	  next: respond
123	
124	respond:
125	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
126	  govern: [ transaction ]

I now have a complete map. Here is the full inventory of every place these identifiers and concepts appear.

## Summary

The identity/membership logic lives almost entirely under the OfficeFloor owner-function package `src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/`, the `Owner` model, the MapStruct `OwnerMapper`, the OpenAPI schema, the DB schemas, and the acceptance tests. The unification target `memberId = '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'` currently exists only as a not-yet-satisfied acceptance test plus scattered "switch point" hooks. Note: the OpenAPI/DB docs for `customerCode` are stale (they describe an old `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` format), while the live code produces `<REGION>-<HASH8>`.

---

## Main source — owner functions

### `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`
The core producer of `customerCode` and the REGION/HASH8/collision logic.
- Lines 15-24 (Javadoc): defines format `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex of SHA-256 over `normalizedTelephone + lastName`; describes collision de-dup via `-<n>`.
- Lines 28-34 `service(...)`: `region + "-" + hash8`, `owner.setCustomerCode(deduplicate(...))`.
- Lines 40-57 `deduplicate(...)`: collision handling against `ownerRepository.findAll()` customerCodes.
- Lines 60-63 `normalizedTelephone(...)`: E.164 normalization.
- Lines 66-80 `sha256Hex8(...)`: SHA-256, first 4 bytes -> 8 upper-hex chars (HASH8).

### `src/main/java/.../owner/OwnerLocality.java` (region code)
- Lines 8-18 Javadoc: region derivation (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; city table fallback; UNKNOWN).
- Lines 24-37: `CITY_REGION`, `REGION_RANGE`, `REGION_TIMEZONE` maps.
- Lines 42-57 `forOwner(...)`: extracts the REGION segment from `customerCode` (`<REGION>-<HASH8>`) by splitting on the first `-`; references `AssignCustomerCode`.
- Lines 68-88 `of(...)` / `regionForPostcode(...)`.

### `src/main/java/.../owner/FiscalYear.java` (fiscal year / FY)
- Lines 8-15 Javadoc: FY starts 1 July, named by ending calendar year (FY26); used by `fiscalYear` field, membership number's year segment, tenure count.
- Lines 22 `START = Month.JULY`; 25-27 `endingYear`; 30-32 `twoDigit` (e.g. "26"); 35-37 `label` -> `"FY"+YY`; 40-42 `elapsed`; 45-47 `forOwner`.

### `src/main/java/.../owner/OwnerSegment.java` (owner segment)
- Lines 7-15 Javadoc: `ownerSegment` = `<TIER>_<AREA>` (PREMIUM/STANDARD × METRO/REGIONAL).
- Line 19 `METRO_REGIONS = {NSW, VIC, QLD}`; lines 24-29 `forOwner(...)` using `OwnerLocality.forOwner`.

### `src/main/java/.../owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` (audit record + membershipNumber)
- Lines 11-21 Javadoc: emits human audit line + structured `OwnerCreatedEvent`.
- Line 24 `AUDIT` logger; line 27 monotonic `SEQUENCE`.
- Lines 30-31: `membershipNumber = customerCode + "-M" + FiscalYear.twoDigit(registrationDate)`.
- Lines 32-35: audit line logs `customerCode`, `membershipLevel`, `membershipNumber`.
- Lines 37-38: emits `OwnerCreatedEvent` JSON.

### `src/main/java/.../owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java` (audit record; memberId switch-point)
- Lines 6-16 Javadoc: JSON `{seq, ownerId, customerCode, membershipLevel, event:"OWNER_CREATED"}`; explicitly notes the `customerCode` field is the "switch point" for future `memberId`.
- Lines 18-19 record fields; line 22 `EVENT="OWNER_CREATED"`.
- Lines 26-32 `forOwner(...)` (marked as the single line to change for `memberId`).
- Lines 35-44 `toJson()` writes `customerCode`.

### `src/main/java/.../owner/OwnerIdentityKey.java` (SHA-256 identity — separate duplicate key)
- Lines 10-23 Javadoc: `identityKey` = lower-hex SHA-256 of `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)`.
- Lines 30-43 `forRequest`/`forOwner`/`of`; lines 57-69 `sha256Hex`. (Full SHA-256 hex, distinct from HASH8.)

### `src/main/java/.../owner/AssignHouseholdId.java` (SHA-256 identity — householdId)
- Lines 12-20 Javadoc; lines 40-43 `householdId(...)`: `"HH-" + sha256Hex(...).substring(0,12)`; lines 53-65 `sha256Hex`. (Related SHA-256 usage; not customerCode.)

### `src/main/java/.../owner/RequireUniqueIdentity.java` (collision/duplicate handling)
- Lines 9-20 Javadoc + lines 22-35 `service(...)`: 409 when whole `identityKey` collides; skips soft-deleted. Uses `OwnerIdentityKey`.

### `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` (pipeline wiring)
- Lines 28-33 `uniqueIdentity` -> `RequireUniqueIdentity` (identityKey duplicate check).
- Lines 60-63 `assignHousehold` -> `AssignHouseholdId`.
- Lines 65-68 `assignCode` -> `AssignCustomerCode`.
- Lines 119-122 `audit` -> `AuditOwnerCreated`.

---

## Main source — model & mapper

### `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- Line 72-73: `@Column(name = "customer_code") private String customerCode;`
- Lines 217-223: `getCustomerCode`/`setCustomerCode`.
- Lines 306-338: fiscal-year tenure logic — `elapsedFiscalYears` (333-335), `fiscalEndingYear` (337-339, uses Month.JULY).
- Lines 341-368: `getMembershipLevel` / `naturalMembershipLevel`.
- Lines 379-404: `getCheckDigit()` — the **Luhn check digit** over the digits of `customerCode` (this is CHK).

### `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
- Lines 26-29: `@Mapping(target = "membershipNumber", ... customerCode + "-M" + FiscalYear.twoDigit(registrationDate))`.
- Lines 30-32: `@Mapping(target = "fiscalYear", ... FiscalYear.forOwner)`.
- Lines 33-35: `@Mapping(target = "locality", ... OwnerLocality.forOwner)`.
- Lines 39-42: `@Mapping(target = "ownerSegment", ... OwnerSegment.forOwner)`.
- Lines 43-45: `@Mapping(target = "identityKey", ... OwnerIdentityKey.forOwner)`.
- (`checkDigit` and `customerCode` are mapped implicitly by name from the Owner getters; no explicit `@Mapping` line.)

### `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`
- Lines 2157-2165 `customerCode` schema (stale doc: `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, example `LON-SMI-0007`).
- Lines 2166-2174 `householdId`; lines 2175-2181 `identityKey`.
- Lines 2193-2200 `fiscalYear` (`FY<YY>`, example `FY26`).
- Lines 2201-2208 `membershipNumber` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`, example `LON-SMI-0007-M26`).
- Lines 2220-2229 `membershipLevel`.
- Lines 2230-2238 `locality` (region derivation).
- Lines 2247-2260 `ownerSegment` (enum PREMIUM_METRO etc.).
- Lines 2271-2280 `checkDigit` (Luhn, 0-9, over customerCode digits, example 4).

---

## Resources — DB schemas (customer_code column, VARCHAR(20))

- `src/main/resources/db/mysql/schema.sql:39` `customer_code VARCHAR(20)` (household_id line 40).
- `src/main/resources/db/h2/schema.sql:41` `customer_code VARCHAR(20)` (household_id line 42).
- `src/main/resources/db/postgres/schema.sql:37` `customer_code VARCHAR(20)` (household_id line 38).
- `src/main/resources/db/hsqldb/schema.sql:48` `customer_code VARCHAR(20)` (household_id line 49).

(No `customer_code` references found in the `data.sql` seed files.)

---

## Test files

### `src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` (the target contract)
- Lines 7-9 Javadoc: states the refactor goal — unify `customerCode` + `membershipNumber` into `memberId = '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'`.
- Lines 13-20 `coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId()`: computes `hash8 = shaHex(telephone + lastName, 8)`, reads `memberId`, asserts it starts with `NSW`, contains `hash8`, and that `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` are gone.

### `src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` (test helpers replicating the algorithms)
- Lines 222-256: pinned region reference data — `CITY_REGION` (228-229), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (232-233), `REGION_POSTCODES` (236-237), `region()` (244-246), `timezone()`, `validPostcode()`.
- Lines 258-265 `knownOwner(city)`.
- Lines 276-299: `sha256hex` (282-294), `shaHex(s, n)` -> first n UPPER-hex chars = HASH8 (297-299).
- Lines 301-321 `luhn(String s)` — reference Luhn check-digit implementation (CHK), mirrors `Owner.getCheckDigit()`.

### `src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java` (audit record capture)
- Lines 12-38: utility that captures the `AUDIT` logger output (used to assert `OwnerCreatedEvent`/audit lines from `AuditOwnerCreated`). No identifier literals, but load-bearing for audit-record tests.

---

## Refactor notes (where `memberId` must converge)

- Producer to change: `AssignCustomerCode.java` (currently `<REGION>-<HASH8>`; needs `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, FY from `FiscalYear`, CHK from Luhn like `Owner.getCheckDigit()`).
- Consumers reading `customerCode`: `OwnerLocality.forOwner` (splits on `-` to get REGION — will break with new format), `AuditOwnerCreated` (membershipNumber + audit line), `OwnerCreatedEvent.forOwner/toJson`, `OwnerMapper` (`membershipNumber`), `Owner.getCheckDigit` (reads customerCode digits).

- Test expectations already pinned: `AcceptanceTest` expects `memberId` with region prefix + HASH8 and absence of the two old fields; `AcceptanceBase` already has `shaHex` (HASH8), `luhn` (CHK), and region tables ready.

composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# An 'Idempotency-Key' header makes the create idempotent: a repeat with an already-seen key
# replays the originally created owner (200) via the 'existing' branch instead of running the
# create pipeline (which would otherwise 409 as a duplicate). An unseen key (or no header)
# takes the 'create' branch — the normal validate-and-create chain below.
route:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RouteIdempotentCreate
  outputs:
    create: validate
    existing: respondExisting

respondExisting:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithExistingOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireOwnerFields
  next: postcode

# Validate the optional postcode WHEN PRESENT (4 digits, and within the city region's range for a
# known region). Absent postcode is accepted, keeping the request contract backward-compatible.
postcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequirePostcode
  next: uniqueIdentity

# Single consolidated duplicate check: reject 409 only when the new owner's WHOLE identityKey
# (SHA-256 hex of normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)) equals an
# existing owner's. Replaces the former separate telephone, email and household checks.
uniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: cityCapacity
cityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: futureDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date (400). Runs on the raw
# request value, before DetermineRegistrationDate defaults/adjusts it.
futureDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireNotFutureRegistrationDate
  next: determineDate

determineDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DetermineRegistrationDate
  next: dailyLimit

dailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesake

assignNamesake:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkWarning

assignBulkWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Flag a city approaching its capacity limit: capacityWarning is true when the city already holds
# 40-49 owners (the hard rejection at 50 is enforced earlier by RequireCityCapacity). Runs before
# save so the owner being created is not counted against itself.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Flag a soft duplicate: an existing owner with a different identityKey that shares this owner's
# soundex(lastName) and postcode. Runs before save so the owner is not matched against itself.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembership

# Cap the new owner's membershipLevel at one above the current maximum among their household
# members. Runs before save so the owner is not counted against itself; no existing member = no cap.
capMembership:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: record

# Remember this owner against the request's Idempotency-Key (when present) so a repeat replays it.
# Runs after save so the owner has its persisted id; no-op when no key was supplied.
record:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it drives the derived salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common abbreviations expanded). An owner is valid when it supplies either a
            non-blank addressLine1 or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.).
            When present it is normalized and appended to addressLine1, separated by a single space,
            to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility; on output it is the composed normalized address — the normalized
            addressLine1 with the normalized addressLine2 appended after a single space when an
            addressLine2 is present, otherwise the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            ('+' followed by 8 to 15 digits); on create a national number is assumed to be '+61'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range.
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            present it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already
            shares its household (same lastName and postcode); the create is then admitted as a
            declared household member instead of being rejected as a household duplicate, and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path for this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space and the
                lastName (e.g. 'DR who'). Falls back to just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps its E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first
                three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned
                at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household, derived from the
                first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized lastName and the postcode, so
                any two owners with the same lastName and postcode share it automatically. Owners
                with no postcode have no household and no householdId.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key that consolidates all duplicate detection,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty
                when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the last two digits of the
                calendar year in which it ends (1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal
                year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is
                present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members,
                and plus 3 when at least one whole fiscal year (starting 1 July) has elapsed since
                registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by preferring the postcode range
                (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves it.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the locality resolves to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the presence of an
                email address. 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0 to 9) computed over the digits contained in
                the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, the owner's city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from birthDate measured against
                registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft
                match that is not a hard identity duplicate); otherwise false. Assigned at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and
                postcode when possibleDuplicate is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true and retains the record. Soft-deleted owners are
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - displayName
            - initials
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it drives the derived salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common abbreviations expanded). An owner is valid when it supplies either a
            non-blank addressLine1 or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.).
            When present it is normalized and appended to addressLine1, separated by a single space,
            to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility; on output it is the composed normalized address — the normalized
            addressLine1 with the normalized addressLine2 appended after a single space when an
            addressLine2 is present, otherwise the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            ('+' followed by 8 to 15 digits); on create a national number is assumed to be '+61'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range.
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when
            present it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already
            shares its household (same lastName and postcode); the create is then admitted as a
            declared household member instead of being rejected as a household duplicate, and is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path for this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space and the
                lastName (e.g. 'DR who'). Falls back to just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps its E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode,
                FY the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 the first eight upper-case
                hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK a single Luhn
                check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. Assigned at creation and
                de-duplicated by appending '-<n>' on collision.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW26A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household, derived from the
                first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized lastName and the postcode, so
                any two owners with the same lastName and postcode share it automatically. Owners
                with no postcode have no household and no householdId.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key that consolidates all duplicate detection,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty
                when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the last two digits of the
                calendar year in which it ends (1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal
                year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is
                present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members,
                and plus 3 when at least one whole fiscal year (starting 1 July) has elapsed since
                registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by preferring the postcode range
                (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves it.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the locality resolves to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise
                'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the presence of an
                email address. 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0 to 9) computed over the digits contained in
                the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, the owner's city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from birthDate measured against
                registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft
                match that is not a hard identity duplicate); otherwise false. Assigned at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and
                postcode when possibleDuplicate is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true and retains the record. Soft-deleted owners are
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - displayName
            - initials
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

        - content

        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page

      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.

          format: int32

        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:

          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.

          title: Birth date

          type: string
          format: date

      required:

        - type: object
          properties:

              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

            visits:
              title: Visits

    PetTypeFields:

              minimum: 0

    User:

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
